description: Aggregate performance of signals created in the last N days (default 30) that have since resolved: hit rate, verified count, average leverage and a breakdown by direction; with an API key also average ROI per signal and cumulative ROI. Use it to judge recent reliability before acting — it returns no individual signals (use get_signals or get_signal_history for those). Public: works without a key. Past results don't predict future results.

apiKey.description: Optional for this tool — aggregate stats are public. Get a free key at https://signals.x70.ai/mcp-signup.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1–90, default 30), counted back from now by signal creation time.

name: get_stats
title: Get Trading Performance Stats
